evidence_meanings.reported_settings: Values from the corresponding saved report/raw metadata; accepted as run settings under the user instruction.

evidence_meanings.linked_completion: Completion hashes bind current report and selected prediction to retained environment/data/code stamp
evidence_meanings.retained_request_bodies: Parameters physically present in retained batch inputs; not proof of provider compliance
evidence_meanings.null: Not recorded, not applicable, or explicitly omitted: consult setting_basis and omitted_request_fields. Original nullable fields are preserved.
evidence_meanings.accepted_settings: Usable parameters assembled under settings_policy; setting_basis identifies report, recipe and temporal attribution.
evidence_meanings.historical_notes: Absent historical hashes/receipts or other record limitations; these do not by themselves make the practical recipe incomplete.

protocol.status: Post-pilot all-pair document-only analysis; exploratory, not preregistered
protocol.sampling: N original documents with replacement; shared draws for every fixed run and pair in each corpus
protocol.fixed_runs: All saved runs and all distinct within/cross-run pairs retain equal weights; no seed-ID resampling
protocol.comparisons: All 190 configuration pairs per dataset, irrespective of P/R/profile closeness or CI sign
protocol.within_reference: Recompute larger available within-configuration mean in each replicate
protocol.zero_denominators: Undefined constituent invalidates the fixed-population mean; each CI reports its own finite replicate count
protocol.interval: Percentile 95%; conditional on saved runs; nominal, exploratory, no FWER or equivalence claim
protocol.profile_sensitivity: ACL and GENIA independently rebuilt from raw gold/train/predictions with configured-typing applicability correction; maximum/support-weighted summaries remain exploratory, not bootstrap equivalence tests
protocol.examples: Every configuration pair; first saved run; first two sorted unique keys per target/direction; no CI selection

protocol.sampling: 317 full text units with replacement; shared multiplicities across all fixed outputs
protocol.run_weighting: equal actual fixed run pairs; no training seed resampling
protocol.within_reference: larger available within-configuration mean, recomputed in each draw
protocol.intervals: nominal exploratory percentile 95%; no multiplicity adjustment or equivalence claim
protocol.profile: current CL raw recall slices at support >=30 plus applicable Class/Boundary/Nested gaps; family weighting exploratory

protocol.matching: Exact offsets anchored; residual one-to-one maximum cardinality, then maximum total character IoU, then lexicographic edge list; within original text unit
protocol.primary: Unlabeled covered gold offset IDs; exact exclusive gold IDs resolved by other run's IoU>=0.5 match
protocol.bootstrap: Existing shared document draws, fixed runs, nominal 95% percentile intervals; no multiplicity correction
protocol.interpretation: Formal gold coverage, not semantic term validity, profile equivalence, or a causal decoder effect

protocol.scope: Current accepted supervised run scores and active applicable profile coordinates; 10/10/11 models x five saved seeds
protocol.empirical_quantile: Nearest rank, ceil(q*n)-1 on all within-configuration run pairs in a corpus; model pairs are dependent
protocol.radial_calibration: q80 of max(max(|delta P|,|delta R|)/0.02, max profile distance/0.05), then scale both original margins equally
protocol.stable_condition: Both configuration means pass the joint margins and at least 20 of 25 cross-configuration saved-run pairs pass them
protocol.limitations: Thresholds chosen from the same test panel are exploratory reference scales, not equivalence margins, significance tests, or a new confirmatory screen. Profiles condition on fixed gold and five saved training seeds.

A01.scope: three fixed corpora and full retained train/dev/test; no pooling

A03.assignment: greedy descending IoU, then descending saved gold and prediction indices
